about_the_game:
Caveman Caravan is a tile-placing, resource gathering puzzle roguelike. Cavemen are organizing in caravans to journey across a land bridge. Help lead them to a new land by filling out the nearby map to provide them resources.

PICK A LEADER

Select your caravan’s leader to determine your starting tiles and tools. Each outlines a different playstyle…and some come with fun secondary effects, too!

GROW YOUR CARAVAN

Each tile and tool you add to your arsenal is representative of a caveman that travels with your caravan. The capacity to find different places, or use a new tool, comes with their presence. Add more members to your caravan as your journey continues to expand your options and increase your capabilities! 

HELP THEM HELP THEMSELVES

Working together, the cavemen can flourish under your direction. Utilize their capabilities in combination with one another to provide them the resources they need to survive. Build surplus by gathering past their needs to earn some backup resources.

EXPLORE YOUR MAP

After each round, you select a tile from the map you filled out to explore! Find different events with different opportunities and effects on your caravan.

OVERCOME HARSH CONDITIONS

At the end of each season, persist through a round with extra effects and conditions that add an extra challenge with extra obstacles to overcome.

LEAD THEM TO A NEW HOME

Survive all 12 rounds to complete the cavemen’s journey to a new home! Earn a completion star on the leader select screen for each leader that you’ve helped on their journey.

UNLOCK NEW LEADERS

The three leaders available at the start aren’t all there is. Meet specific conditions and you can unlock more leaders with more playstyles and different looks!

FIND SECRETS

And more…?

Enjoy your time in this retro-style arcade puzzle game with a bit of modern touch, inspired by other modern retro games like UFO50!
